1.explanation: The documents related to the 'menu' component are necessary because the bug is specifically about the behavior of Menu Items and their title attributes. The 'index' and 'adaptor' files provide the core implementation details, while the 'demo' files show how the menu is used, particularly in hover and select scenarios. The 'config-provider' documents are relevant because one proposed solution involves adding an API to the ConfigProvider to control the title attribute, so understanding its current implementation and usage is crucial.
1.bug_scenario: The bug report discusses the issue of whether the 'title' attribute should be automatically added to Menu Items. Currently, the title is added, allowing users to see all collapsed text when hovering for 3 seconds, and screen readers can read it. However, this causes issues when the title and innerText are identical, violating WCAG principles, and some users do not want the title tooltip. Three solutions are proposed: using 'aria-label' instead of 'title', providing a ConfigProvider API to control title visibility, and conditionally setting the title based on the content type of Menu.Item children.
